skill.summary: Designs a weekend wind-down ritual that combines weekly review, light cleanup, planning, preparation, and recovery without turning rest into another job.

latestVersion.changelog:
Weekend Reset Routine Designer v1.0.0

- Initial release of the "Weekend Reset Routine Designer" skill.
- Guides users to create a practical weekend reset ritual tailored to time, energy, household, and personal needs.
- Offers flexible routine templates, including low- and high-energy variations, checklists, and test plans.
- Emphasizes recovery and routine realism; avoids overload and routine creep.
- Adheres to boundaries: not for mental health/medical advice, avoids shaming, and prioritizes user wellbeing.
